proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ x hx h0
  let a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply h0
    have := congrArg (algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K) h
    simpa [a] using this
  exact NumberField.exists_conjugate_one_le_norm ha
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (x : K), IsIntegral ℤ x → x ≠ 0 → ∃ σ : K →+* ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖σ x‖
